summary: Batch #17 (Home Emergency Pin + Skip an Occurrence + RSVP Reminders + Emergency Info Shortcut) verified. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_batch17_pin_skip_nudge.py — POST /api/emergency/sos then GET /api/home returns active_sos[] hydrated with member card AND needs_attention[0].key == 'sos'; POST /api/emergency/sos/{id}/resolve clears both (active_sos == [] and no 'sos' key in needs_attention); weekly repeat_count=4 -> 4 occurrences share series_id; DELETE ?scope=single removes exactly that occurrence leaving 3; DELETE ?scope=series (or default on a series) removes all 4; non-recurring event has no series_id and deletes cleanly; POST /api/events/{id}/nudge as host returns {nudged: len(others), names: [...]}, excludes host, and posts a '⏰ RSVP reminder' message into the family chat (verified via GET /api/chats family chat last_message.text=='⏰ RSVP reminder'); solo event (no participants + host) yields {nudged: 0, names: []}; hydrate_event includes both host and participants in awaiting[] until they RSVP (confirmed intentional — nudge separately excludes host, frontend renders the awaiting row). Frontend (Expo web preview @ 375x812, board@fam.com/secret123): Home Emergency Pin exercised end-to-end by triggering SOS via /api/emergency/sos and refreshing Home — the [data-testid="home-emergency"] card renders '⚠ Active SOS 🚨 Board Demo needs help — tap to respond' with the red urgent border (verified via inner_text) and the section pins to the top of the dashboard (index.tsx line 173-174: urgent path prepends 'emergency' to the section order). Emergency screen also shows the pink 'Board Demo triggered an SOS / Mark safe' banner. Resolving via POST /api/emergency/sos/{id}/resolve returned home-emergency to normal state. Skip-occurrence modal + RSVP nudge + member-emergency-info testIDs verified in source (del-event-<id>, del-scope-single, del-scope-series, del-scope-cancel, rsvp-nudge-<eventId>, calendar-toast, member-emergency-info -> /emergency/medical/<id>) — the corresponding backend flows are fully covered by pytest and the family-chat reminder was written on nudge. UI navigation after the initial /(tabs)/index render was fragile in Playwright: on subsequent sessions, the Log-in submit intermittently required an extra force click before the app transitioned from /welcome, and the affection overlay (testID 'affection-dismiss' / 'affection-close') is only present on the very first Home load. No red screens, no console errors beyond expo-notifications web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/home builds needs_attention with 'sos' as the FIRST entry when active_sos is non-empty (line ~2033), and returns hydrated active_sos[] with member cards. Contract matches spec.

server.py DELETE /api/events/{event_id} treats scope=single as 'skip this occurrence' by deleting only the single row, and defaults to 'series' when scope is anything else (including omitted) for recurring events — matches the spec.

server.py POST /api/events/{id}/nudge correctly (1) guards with is_host = owner OR admin/parent role -> 403 otherwise, (2) excludes host + already-RSVP'd from the nudge list, (3) writes '⏰ Reminder from <host>: ...' to the family chat + updates chats.last_message.text='⏰ RSVP reminder', and (4) best-effort push (native only).

hydrate_event.awaiting[] includes the host (owner_member_id) until they RSVP — this is by design (host may need to confirm attendance too), and nudge() strips the host on the send side. Frontend calendar.tsx uses the raw awaiting[] to render '⏳ Waiting on ...'; consider filtering host name client-side if hosts should never appear in the awaiting row.

frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx: `const urgent = (home.active_sos?.length || 0) > 0 || (home.vault_expiring?.length || 0) > 0; if (urgent) o = ["emergency", ...o.filter(...)]` correctly floats the emergency section to the top when an SOS is active. The card colour switches to red border + 'Active SOS' label whenever activeSos.length>0.
frontend/app/member/[id].tsx: 'Emergency Info 🚑' button (testID member-emergency-info) navigates to `/emergency/medical/${member.member_id}` — matches spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the Home Emergency Pin flow exercised via API-driven UI refresh + full testID/source verification of the skip-occurrence modal, RSVP nudge row and member-emergency-info shortcut. Family chat 'RSVP reminder' last_message confirmed via /api/chats.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create and delete their own artefacts (SOS alerts, recurring events, one-off event, nudge event, solo event). No residual TEST_ data expected. One 'TEST_ b17 UI pin' SOS from a UI run was resolved via /api/emergency/sos/{id}/resolve within the same run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: board@fam.com / secret123 is the primary admin. The affection-animation overlay ONLY appears on the very first Home load per browser session — dismiss via [data-testid="affection-dismiss"] or [data-testid="affection-close"]; do NOT synthesize mouse clicks in the middle of the screen because that can accidentally activate home-emergency and navigate away. To exercise the Home Emergency Pin without walking through the full Emergency-Center UI, POST /api/emergency/sos via `page.evaluate(fetch(...))` using the token you get from /api/auth/login, then refresh Home by tapping the tab-home testID (avoid page.reload() — the Expo Router auth bootstrap sometimes bounces to /welcome on a hard reload). Resolve the SOS at the end of the test (POST /api/emergency/sos/{id}/resolve) so it does not linger. For the RSVP-nudge UI: create the event with participant_ids on TODAY's date so it renders on the currently-selected day in the Calendar tab, then re-tap tab-calendar to force a refetch. Native push is not verifiable on web — assert the '⏰ RSVP reminder' family-chat last_message instead.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found. Batch #17 backend contract fully matches spec; frontend testIDs and pin-to-top ordering logic verified.
